novel_features.name: Fleet refresh
novel_features.description: Refresh tenants, endpoints, alerts, account health and licences for every non-trial customer tenant in one run, with a per-tenant ok/forbidden/error ledger (add --include-trial for trial tenants).

novel_features.name: Fleet triage queue
novel_features.description: One ranked work queue across all customers: open high and medium alerts, bad or suspicious endpoints, tamper protection off, isolated or stale devices.

novel_features.name: Fleet health ranking
novel_features.description: Rank customers worst-first by Account Health Check score with sub-scores and the change since the previous fleet refresh.

novel_features.name: Fleet gap analysis
novel_features.description: Per-customer security and commercial gaps: low protection, partial tamper protection, risky exclusions, unencrypted or unlicensed devices, licence over-usage or expiry.

novel_features.name: Fleet revenue ranking
novel_features.description: Rank customers by monthly Sophos revenue for a billing month (partner credential only) and compare billed quantities with deployed endpoints counted by the last fleet refresh.

novel_features.name: Cross-tenant containment
novel_features.description: Isolate (contain) machines by hostname, IP or endpoint ID without knowing the tenant: resolves the tenant from the fleet refresh index (or searches one --tenant live), previews isolation plus optional scan, forensic log and alert acknowledgement, and runs only with --yes.

novel_features.name: Fleet tamper remediation
novel_features.description: Find supported endpoints with tamper protection off across non-trial customers and, with --yes, turn it back on; tenants whose tenant-wide tamper setting is off are reported, not changed.

novel_features.name: Fleet SIEM collector
novel_features.description: Pull SIEM events and alerts for every tenant from each tenant's saved cursor as NDJSON, warning when a cursor fell outside the 24-hour window (CLI and cron only; not exposed as an MCP tool).
